verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents its own reporting: the plans let you build reports, the MCP server can produce flow performance reports, and the API lets you pull data to analyze marketing performance. None of this spells out the specific metrics, per-step automation breakdowns, or time-series views the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit open/click/unsubscribe/conversion metrics, per-campaign and per-flow-step reporting docs, over-time trend views, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: Your MCP client can help with a variety of tasks from campaign creation to flow performance reports.
Pull data from Klaviyo to create dashboards, sync to other systems, and perform analysis to keep up with your marketing performance.
use the drag-and-drop email/SMS editors and build automations, segmentation and reports
